release5_2_13_rc_2Change2: Keep Outline collections, page icons, table images and original attachment labels when importing Markdown exports.
release5_2_13_rc_2Change3: Restore collection emoji from Outline JSON exports and render imported warnings, information and tips as callout blocks.
release5_2_6Change1: Open Media conversations with fewer repeated reads for reactions and author profiles.
release5_2_6Change2: Keep reaction visibility and profile presence up to date when access changes.
release5_2_5Change1: Open Drive folders and recent files with fewer repeated metadata reads.
release5_2_5Change2: Keep private file previews and downloads responsive as collections grow.
release5_2_4Change1: Show reactions below photos and albums without extending the message background.
release5_2_4Change2: Keep captions and timestamps inside the message while reactions wrap on narrow screens.
release5_2_3Change1: See existing file and folder links first, with readable addresses and copy buttons.
release5_2_3Change2: Create another link in a separate tab without losing the form settings.
release5_2_3Change3: Retry loading links after an error and navigate the dialog with the keyboard.
release5_2_2Change1: Keep Drive navigation and tools visible while opening folders.
release5_2_2Change2: Show folder loading errors without discarding the current view.
release5_2_2Change3: Keep the latest folder selected when responses arrive out of order.
release5_2_1Change1: The task module name follows English interface settings.
release5_2_1Change2: Floating navigation stays out of the way while mobile reminder settings are open.
release5_2_1Change3: Updated compatibility checks cover administration, messaging, mobile controls and both interface languages.
release5_2_0Change1: Delete a task and its subtasks together, with seven days to restore the branch.
release5_2_0Change2: Project deletion pauses the remaining task recovery time; restoring the project resumes it.
release5_2_0Change3: Expired task branches and their attachments are cleaned up together.
release5_1_2Change1: Keep notifications, chat and shared notes responsive while more clients are connected.
release5_1_2Change2: Load chat history with fewer database requests while preserving access checks.
release5_1_1Title: Note downloads and localized release notes
release5_1_1Change1: Download file attachments from read-only and synchronized notes.
release5_1_1Change2: Release titles and change lists follow the interface language.
release5_1_1Change3: The project search clear button stays aligned and preserves other filters.
release5_1_0Change1: Cancel tasks with an optional reason, preserve their content and reopen them later.
release5_1_0Change2: Cancelled tasks have their own status and counter, leave unfinished views, and do not count towards epic completion.
release5_1_0Change3: Owners and administrators can see an available stable GitHub release below the installed server version.
release5_1_0Change4: Installed Web App names use DrG Space.
release5_1_0Change5: The media gallery uses Media naming and a photo icon in navigation.
release5_0_2Change1: Docker containers, images, Compose project and diagnostic labels use DrG Space names.
release5_0_2Change2: Existing data volumes can be pinned as external volumes when changing the Compose project.
release5_0_2Change3: Downloaded backups use the DrG Space filename; existing backup formats and tokens stay compatible.
release5_2_1Change4: Note and image imports preserve their behavior while unused maintenance code is removed.
release5_2_1Change5: Cancelled downloads release the storage lock even before response headers arrive, so backups can proceed.
release5_2_7Change1: Stop automatic Media conversation and preview refreshes while the page is hidden or after leaving chats.
release5_2_7Change2: Skip history requests for known empty Media groups and limit simultaneous preview downloads.
release5_2_8Change1: Read the current call without scanning other people's calls or taking an extra write lock during ordinary polling.
release5_2_8Change2: Receive incoming call changes through the live inbox, with fast fallback when the subscription is unavailable.
release5_2_8Change3: Keep call expiry and sensitive signaling cleanup under the shared maintenance lease.
release5_2_9Change1: Reserve album layouts and use stored single-photo and video dimensions before previews load.
release5_2_9Change2: Keep active scrolling uninterrupted by applying Media preview sizing and older messages once the gesture settles.
release5_2_9Change3: Avoid repeating history layout when background updates contain no changes.
release5_2_9Change4: Show regular and family conversations together when opening chats.
release5_2_9Change5: Keep video preview images visible while scrolling until the first playback frame is ready.
release5_2_10Change1: Reuse generated Drive thumbnails instead of repeatedly processing the full photograph.
release5_2_10Change2: Keep previews private and clean up old thumbnails when their source is replaced or permanently deleted.
release5_2_10Change3: Limit temporary thumbnail storage without changing original files or their storage quota.
release5_2_11Change1: Update a security dependency while preserving saved data, settings and client compatibility.
release5_2_12Change1: Resume an interrupted private Drive download from the last received byte when the file is unchanged.
release5_2_12Change2: Start a fresh download if the file was replaced during an interruption.
release5_2_12Change3: Retry an interrupted Drive upload when file storage returns without resending files already saved.
release5_2_12Change4: Show when file storage is temporarily unavailable before a download starts.
release5_2_12Change5: Check database readiness independently of the application process.
